location: Swan Hill, Murray Valley Region, VIC, Australia
nicknames: Home of the Swan Hill Cup

main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu and Rye grass on sandy loam river soil base)
main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Premier country racing venue in the Murray Valley region of Victoria operated by the Swan Hill Jockey Club. Features a spacious 1,900m oval circuit with broad turns and a massive 475-metre home straight that rises slightly uphill to the post. The grueling 475m straight serves as a true stamina test, preventing front-runner locks and giving closing swoopers ('S' and 'C' styles) and mid-pack stalkers ('P') every opportunity to run down early leaders.
main_turf.post_bias: FAIR DRAW ACROSS ALL DISTANCES: The large 1,900m circumference and long 475m home straight eliminate extreme barrier penalties. Over 975m and 1200m sprint dashes, inside-to-middle barriers (draws 2-6) offer a mild advantage into the home turn.

handicapping_angles.massive_475m_uphill_straight_swooper_boo: Swan Hill boasts one of the longest home straights in Victorian regional racing (475 metres). Do not automatically toss deep closers ('C' / 'Swoopers'); the 475m uphill run heavily rewards horses with strong L400m closing sectionals (+3.0 pts stretch stamina angle).
handicapping_angles.swan_hill_cup_3_day_carnival_metro_class: During the June 3-Day Swan Hill Cup Carnival ($175k+ Swan Hill Cup, Elvstroem Classic), major Melbourne metropolitan yards send high-grade runners. Upgrade horses shipping from Flemington, Caulfield, Sandown, and Cranbourne over local country runners (+3.5 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.border_shippers_from_nsw_riverina: Located on the Murray River border, Swan Hill frequently attracts NSW Riverina trainers (Wagga, Albury, Deniliquin, Echuca). Cross-reference Victorian country speed figures against NSW country form lines.
handicapping_angles.victorian_country_benchmark_weight_penal: In Victorian Country Benchmark handicaps (BM58-BM78), topweights carrying 60kg+ face a physical tax on the 475m uphill stretch. Favor fit, well-weighted runners receiving apprentice weight relief.
